area_description: Carbon offsetting and emissions reporting for international flights.

idea_types.name: CORSIA offsetting
idea_types.description: Helping airlines meet CORSIA by supplying or managing eligible emissions units that offset growth in international flight emissions.

rules.document: CORSIA - Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation
rules.why_it_applies: Explains the global scheme that makes airlines offset growth in international CO2 emissions.
Contains the CORSIA standards for monitoring, reporting, verification and offsetting.
Lists the emissions units that airlines may use to meet CORSIA offsetting requirements.
Explains the international approach to market-based measures such as offsetting.

readiness_checklist: Description of the offset activity and what it removes or avoids
Evidence the activity is eligible under CORSIA
Registry or programme the units would come from
How the reduction is measured and verified
Expected volume of units and timeline
reviewer_questions: Is the programme and activity on the CORSIA eligible list?
How are reductions measured and verified?
How do you prevent the same reduction being counted twice?
How many units can you deliver, and when?
idea_types.national_requirements: Check with your civil aviation authority for the national requirements that also apply.
